title: Assaults on teachers and students trigger school alerts
seoTitle: School violence alerts: Teacher and student safety
subtitle: Rising violence in Brazilian schools sparks debate on safety and school routines.
excerpt: Rising assaults on teachers and students in Brazil spark debate on safety, school environment, and mental health.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Recent cases of violence involving students and education professionals in school environments have generated significant repercussions and placed the issue of aggression at the center of attention in the country. Recent surveys and judicial decisions have highlighted the frequency of physical and psychological violence episodes within public and private educational institutions.

Rise in assaults against teachers

Recent research indicates that violence against education professionals has become a frequent problem in Brazilian institutions. Surveys show that a significant proportion of teachers have suffered some form of psychological or physical aggression in the school environment, generating constant fear, daily pressure, and a high number of leaves due to mental disorders.

Insecurity and vulnerability in school routines

The sense of insecurity affects a large portion of educators, particularly female teachers, who are among the groups most vulnerable to verbal abuse and intimidation. Experts point out that the difficulty in setting boundaries and the lack of rigor in accountability create an environment conducive to violence becoming part of the routine for those working in schools.

Court upholds conviction for abuse

In the judicial sphere, the Court of Justice upheld a teacher's conviction for assaulting children in a school. The decision confirmed a prison sentence in a closed regime following investigations based on surveillance camera footage, forensic reports, and testimonies that proved physical aggression against young students.

The need for protocols and institutional support

Faced with the scenario of violence and the mental deterioration of professionals, educators and organizations emphasize the urgency for clear protocols, psychological support, effective family participation, and greater institutional responsibility to ensure the physical and mental integrity of everyone involved in the school community.

With information from VEJA, realnews.com.br, G1.
